name: 纹理一致性分析
description: 测量 texture detail variation 跨 image regions. Real photos have naturally varying textures, while AI tends to produce unnaturally consistent 纹理模式.
mechanism: Computes GLCM texture 特征 跨 multiple orientations and distances. AI images produce more uniform texture statistics, while real photos show natural spatial variation.
parameters: Distances: [1, 2, 4], Angles: [0, 45, 90, 135 degrees], Features: 对比度, 相关性, energy, homogeneity
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80% for detecting texture uniformity 异常
source: Haralick et al. (1973), adapted by Qian et al. (2020)
useCase: Identifying AI-typical uniform 纹理模式

references.title: Ojala, T. et al. (2002). Multiresolution Gray-Scale and Rotation Invariant Texture Classification. IEEE TPAMI.
Liu, Z. et al. (2020). Global Texture Enhancement for Fake Face Detection in the Wild. CVPR.

strengths:
• Multi-directional 纹理分析 through GLCM
• Captures spatial relationships 之间 pixels
• Effective for detecting uniform AI textures
• Well-established in image 分析 literature
limitations:
• Uniform real surfaces (walls, sky) create 误报
• Sensitive to image 分辨率 changes
• Computation increases with number of distance/angle pairs
• Post-processing can normalize texture 特征
